advanced_cloak_ability.name: Advanced Cloak
advanced_cloak_ability.description: Reduces the cooldown of Force Cloak by 30s at 3 pieces, 90s at 4 pieces, and 105s at 5 pieces — enabling significantly more frequent stealth entries for shadow-focused Jedi.

advanced_smoke_bomb_ability.name: Advanced Smoke Bomb
advanced_smoke_bomb_ability.description: Enhances Smoke Bomb so that detonation automatically conceals the Assassin in stealth (30s invisibility), enabling immediate re-engagement or escape after the bomb drops.

affliction_ability.name: Affliction
affliction_ability.description: Enables a stacking damage-over-time effect on the target. Each application adds another layer of the affliction, increasing total DoT damage over the duration of combat.

basic_attacks_to_aoe.name: Basic Attacks to AoE
basic_attacks_to_aoe.description: Converts the Pikeman's basic attacks into area-of-effect strikes that hit all nearby enemies, dramatically increasing sustained cleave damage in melee-range groups.

cripple_cooldown_reset.name: Cripple Cooldown Reset
cripple_cooldown_reset.description: Passively resets the cooldown of Cripple when triggered, allowing the Bounty Hunter to rapidly reapply the snare and root effects without waiting for the normal cooldown.
cripple_cooldown_reset.grantedBy: Bounty Hunter — Dire Fate Set (3–5 pieces)

flawless_strike_ability.name: Flawless Strike
flawless_strike_ability.description: A precision shot that activates a 6-second proc window. When the proc fires it grants +50% Strikethrough Chance for 15 seconds, allowing the Rifleman's attacks to bypass defenses.

guardian_strike_ability.name: Guardian Strike
guardian_strike_ability.description: A powerful retaliatory strike available to guardian-spec Jedi. Strikes back against attackers with Force-enhanced power, dealing heavy damage while reinforcing the Jedi's defensive stance.

how_are_you_ability.name: How Are You?
how_are_you_ability.description: A Smuggler misdirection technique that catches the target off guard, briefly disrupting their combat actions and creating an opening for follow-up attacks or a clean getaway.

lasting_performance_ability.name: Lasting Performance
lasting_performance_ability.description: A sustained 2-hour performance buff applied via music. Grants +15% movement speed, +150 Constitution, and -5% action costs — keeping allies in peak condition throughout extended sessions.

masterful_grace_ability.name: Masterful Grace
masterful_grace_ability.description: An evasive combat technique granting the Assassin heightened defensive reflexes. Combined with the set's increased Strikethrough, action efficiency, and near-immunity to snares and roots for fluid shadow combat.

preparation_h_ability.name: Preparation H
preparation_h_ability.description: Applies an 8-second debuff to the target that reduces their Dodge by 40, Evasion by 40, and Block by 40 — stripping defensive layers and making them significantly more vulnerable to follow-up attacks.

smoke_bomb_cooldown_reduction.name: Smoke Bomb Cooldown Reduction
smoke_bomb_cooldown_reduction.description: Reduces Smoke Bomb cooldown by 30s at 3 pieces, 90s at 4 pieces, and 105s at 5 pieces — allowing near-constant access to the Assassin's primary escape and engagement tool.

stealth_strike_ability.name: Stealth Strike
stealth_strike_ability.description: A 6-second shadow technique that applies 4 stacks of Impossible Odds, reduces the target's incoming healing by 60%, and enables a Pistol Whip follow-up — combining burst pressure with anti-heal disruption.

tactical_advantage_ability.name: Tactical Advantage
tactical_advantage_ability.description: A Pistoleer combat technique that establishes a tactical edge, increasing the effectiveness of precision fire and setting up advantageous attack angles against the target.

trader_heal.name: Emergency Heal
trader_heal.description: A trader's last ditch effort to keep oneself alive.
